purpose: Reduce exposure temporarily after losing trades without changing entries, exits, stops, targets or signal generation.

candidate_rules.fast_5x: 10x normally; after any losing trade, next trade uses 5x; any winning trade resets next trade to 10x.
candidate_rules.slow_A: 10x normally; after a loss go to 5x; after first subsequent win go to 7.5x; after second subsequent win return to 10x; a new loss returns to 5x.
candidate_rules.slow_B: 10x normally; first loss -> 5x; second consecutive loss -> 2.5x; recovery is one tier per subsequent win: 2.5 -> 5 -> 7.5 -> 10.

interpretation: Loss-streak scaling materially improves the June-August drawdown without changing the strategy signals.
The simple one-loss brake is robust across a broad reduced-leverage neighborhood (2.5x through 7.5x) in June-August, so 5x is not a single magic value.
No loss-streak brake rescues January-May because the underlying strategy expectancy is persistently adverse; this supports a later separate market-regime gate.
Do not promote any candidate until period/regime analysis and additional out-of-sample validation are complete.
